name: Saint John the Apostle
history: The beloved disciple, who leaned on the Lord's breast at the Last Supper, stood at the foot of the cross and took Mary into his home. He wrote the fourth Gospel, three letters and the Apocalypse, and is the only apostle believed not to have died a martyr.
meditation: Little children, love one another. In old age, they say, this was all he would preach.
life: John was a son of Zebedee and, with his brother James, a fisherman on the Sea of Galilee. Jesus called the brothers the sons of thunder, and once they wanted to call down fire on a Samaritan village that would not receive Him. With Peter and James, John saw the raising of Jairus's daughter, the Transfiguration and the agony in Gethsemane. Tradition identifies him with the disciple whom Jesus loved, who ran with Peter to the empty tomb and recognised the risen Lord on the shore. After Pentecost he preached with Peter in Jerusalem, and Paul names him one of the pillars of the Church. Tradition holds that he was exiled to Patmos and lived to great age at Ephesus, where he cared for Mary. On his feast wine is blessed, recalling a legend that he drank a poisoned cup unharmed.
prayerTo: Saint John, beloved disciple, you rested on the heart of Christ and stood by His cross with His mother. Pray that I may know how much I am loved by God, and learn to love in return. Take me with you into the mystery of the Word made flesh, and teach me to love my neighbour. Amen.
penance: Read the first chapter of John's Gospel slowly today. Make a deliberate act of kindness to someone in your family.
prayer: O Lord, graciously shed light upon Your Church, so that, enlightened by the teachings of blessed John, Your Apostle and Evangelist, she may gain Your everlasting rewards. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
prayerSource: Collect of the day, Roman Missal of 1962
